comment: MediaFlow curated opportunity catalog — real, well-known programs with official links. Refreshed periodically; live APIs (Remotive/Arbeitnow/RemoteOK/MLH) are merged at runtime by /api/mf/discover.

items.title: Google STEP Intern — Software Engineering
items.description: STEP (Student Training in Engineering Program) is a 10-12 week summer internship for first and second-year students in Computer Science or related fields. Includes a dedicated mentor, real project work and a skills bootcamp.

items.title: Microsoft Engage Program
items.description: Engage is Microsoft's student engagement and mentorship track: work in pods with Microsoft mentors on Azure-based projects, with a path to internship interviews for top performers.

items.title: Amazon WOW — Women of the World
items.description: Amazon WOW is a workshop + hiring series for women in engineering colleges across India, leading to software development internships and full-time offers.

items.title: Flipkart GRiD — Hiring Challenge
items.description: GRiD is Flipkart's flagship engineering campus challenge — coding and problem-solving rounds with internship and pre-placement offers for winners.

items.title: Research Internship Program
items.description: Adobe Research hosts graduate and undergraduate interns to work with research scientists on imaging, ML, document intelligence and creative AI.

items.title: UberSTAR Software Engineering Internship
items.description: UberSTAR is Uber's flagship early-career internship: 12-16 weeks embedded in a product team working on maps, marketplace or platform engineering.

items.title: Smart India Hackathon 2026
items.company: Ministry of Education, Govt. of India
items.description: World's largest hackathon: student teams solve real problem statements from central ministries and industries; winners get national recognition and prize support.

items.title: TCS CodeVita
items.description: CodeVita is TCS's global programming contest — multiple rounds of competitive programming with interview shortlists and job offers.

items.title: IEEE Xtreme 19.0 — 24-hour Programming
items.description: IEEE's flagship 24-hour global programming competition for student members, with ranks, prizes and community bragging rights.

items.title: Google Solution Challenge
items.description: Build solutions for one or more UN Sustainable Development Goals using Google technologies. Mentored by Googlers; top teams demo to the world.

items.title: MIT Hacking Medicine
items.description: The world's leading health hackathon series — multidisciplinary teams prototype patient-facing and clinician-facing solutions in a weekend.

items.title: Grace Hopper Celebration 2026
items.description: The world's largest gathering of women technologists — technical sessions, a giant career expo and a famously productive hiring floor.

items.title: AWS re:Invent 2026
items.description: AWS's annual cloud learning conference: keynotes, 2000+ sessions, certifications and one of the strongest networking floors in tech.

items.title: Google I/O 2027
items.description: Google's developer festival — Android, AI/GenAI, web and cloud launches live, with hands-on codelabs and expert Q&A.

items.title: PyCon India 2026
items.description: The largest Python conference in India — talks, workshops, dev sprints and a jobs wall for Pythonistas.

items.title: Web Summit 2026
items.description: 70,000+ attendees, from early-stage founders to Fortune 500 engineering leaders; a genuinely productive place to meet hiring teams.

items.title: NVIDIA GTC 2027
items.description: NVIDIA's AI conference — the place to see where on-device and accelerated AI is going, straight from the labs building it.

items.title: Google Summer of Code 2027
items.description: GSoC pairs student contributors with open-source mentoring organizations for a paid 12+ week summer of real production code. One of the strongest open-source credentials a student can earn.

items.title: MITACS Globalink Research Internship
items.description: A 12-week fully-funded summer research internship at Canadian universities for senior undergraduates, with a path to graduate-school funding.

items.title: DAAD WISE — Working Internships in Science and Engineering
items.description: Funded summer research internships at German universities and institutes for students of IITs, NITs and other top Indian engineering colleges.

items.title: Summer Research Fellowship Programme (SRFP)
items.description: Two-month guided summer research under scientists of the three national science academies at IISc, IITs, CSIR labs and other premier institutes.

items.title: Charpak Lab Internship
items.company: Embassy of France in India / Campus France
items.description: Funded 2-3 month lab internships in France for Indian bachelor's and master's students, including placements at CNRS and university labs.

items.title: Research Fellow Program
items.description: A 1-2 year pre-doctoral research position for fresh graduates — work with MSR India researchers on AI, systems and tech-for-society projects.

items.title: Google Research India — Student & Research Programs
items.description: Google Research's Bangalore lab — from on-device ML to large-scale foundation models — hosts interns, pre-doctoral researchers and visiting students.

items.title: MIT Media Lab — Research Opportunities
items.description: The Media Lab's antidisciplinary studio model — research internships and visiting positions across 25+ research groups inventing the future of human-computer interaction.

items.title: IBM Research India
items.description: IBM's India research lab works on foundation models for code, hybrid cloud and quantum — with structured internship and blue-skies research tracks.

items.title: Qualcomm India Innovation Fellowship
items.description: Fellowship for PhD and masters students to pursue research ideas with Qualcomm mentors and lab access — funding, hardware and joint publication support.

items.title: TCS Research — Internship & Innovation Programs
items.description: TCS Research runs one of India's largest industrial research labs, with structured internships for students and joint projects with universities.

items.title: Entrepreneur First — Cohort Program
items.description: EF backs individuals pre-team and pre-idea: a stipended cohort where you meet your co-founder and build a deep-tech startup from scratch.

items.title: Y Combinator — Apply for Batch
items.description: The world's most famous startup accelerator — $500k standard deal, 3-month batch and a lifetime alumni network. No-idea and pre-idea founders do get in.

items.title: Startup School (free, self-paced)
items.description: Y Combinator's free 8-week online course: how to find an idea, talk to users, launch and grow — with advice directly from the partners.

items.title: Climatebase Fellowship — Cohort
items.description: A remote climate-career accelerator: project sprints with real climate companies, mentorship and hiring introductions — built for people transitioning into climate.

items.title: Product Management Fellowship
items.description: A selective remote PM fellowship for engineers moving into product: real product problems, PM mentors from top Indian startups.
